label: Health check: every sentence

params.name: disk_low
params.default: Only {gb} GB left on the data disk - clear old videos (Storage) before work stops
params.label: disk low

params.name: cert_low
params.default: Certificate ending soon: {hosts} - renew it (certbot) before visitors see a warning
params.label: cert low

params.name: bell_new
params.default: {n} new {n:thing needs|things need} you: {names} - see the warning bar
params.label: bell new

params.name: work_bad
params.default: {names} - the last run did not finish; open Agents, read why and run it again
params.label: work bad

params.name: ready_disk
params.default: not ready: the data folder cannot be written ({why})
params.label: ready disk

params.name: ready_db
params.default: not ready: database {db} does not answer ({why})
params.label: ready db

params.name: drill_ok
params.default: Last restore drill {at}: {backup} restored, {checked} files checked, the api answered.
params.label: drill ok

params.name: drill_old
params.default: The last good restore drill was {days} days ago ({at}) - the most allowed is {max} days. Check the drill's cron line.
params.label: drill old

params.name: drill_never
params.default: No restore drill has run on this server. Run tools/restore_drill.py once and add its monthly cron line (DEPLOY.md).
params.label: drill never

params.name: drill_not_here
params.default: No backups on this computer, so no restore drill.
params.label: drill not here

params.name: security_ok
params.default: No security event to tell ({n} recorded in the last {hours} h).
params.label: security ok

params.name: sec_mcp_key
params.default: A new AI key or app connection was made by {who} ({at}).
params.label: sec mcp key

params.name: sec_first_account
params.default: The first account (the owner) was taken by {target} ({at}).
params.label: sec first account

params.name: stale_say
params.default: has not run for {days} {days:day|days} - this bar may be out of date. Check that agent ag_health still runs
params.label: stale say
